sources.items/ashlight-lantern.png: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single two-frame inventory sprite sheet for an original dark Gothic dungeon game, painterly rendered art rather than pixel art. Make a landscape sheet with EXACTLY TWO equally sized side-by-side isolated views of the SAME squat brass Ashlight Lantern, each fully contained in its own half with generous clear margins. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no floor, no backdrop, no labels or lettering, no drop shadow. The lantern is a small practical belt lantern: sturdy low brass cage, soot-blackened glass, rounded top with a simple carrying loop, aged brass edges readable at tiny 64px icon size, a low amber ember inside instead of a wick. Left frame: shutter OPEN, a warm concentrated orange ember glowing behind soot-streaked glass; the hinged brass shutter folds against its side. Right frame: the SAME design, scale, perspective and materials with the opaque brass shutter CLOSED across the glass; no emitted light or halo. Three-quarter front view, broad clear silhouette, restrained fine brush texture, warm brass highlights against charcoal soot, strong contour contrast. The verbs are fire and light. No holy symbols, crosses, radiant sunbursts, skull decorations, blue magic, modern handles, candles, oil reservoirs, UI frames, or environment. Keep both icons separate, centered at x=25% and x=75%; no overlap.
